name: Urborg Phantom
oracle_text:
This creature can't block.
{U}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature this turn.
blocked_sentences: {U}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only: true` option on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (a field on PermanentShield read by the damage primitives), so a resolving activated ability can install a this-turn shield on its own source ({"self_only": true}) that stops only COMBAT damage dealt to and dealt by it, leaving noncombat damage to and from it untouched
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` with dealt: to_and_by and duration: this_turn is the right shape but PermanentShield has no combat filter (op_options are only dealt, duration, objects), so it would also prevent noncombat damage such as burn or fight; `combat_only` exists only on the `prevent_damage` static, which is continuous on a printed permanent, only faces 'to', and cannot be switched on for one turn by an activated ability. 'This creature can't block' alone is expressible as the `cant_block` static with affects self_only
